mapper.insert: insert into sys_alarm_type_industry_rel(alarm_type_id, industry_code, is_visible, creator, create_time, modifier, update_time, delete_flag, tenant_id, app_ver_code, type_value) values(#{body.alarmTypeId}, #{body.industryCode}, #{body.isVisible}, #{body.creator}, now(), #{body.modifier}, now(), '0', #{body.tenantId}, #{body.appVerCode}, #{body.typeValue})
mapper.select:
select t.* from ( select DISTINCT sat.alarm_type_id AS alarmTypeId, sat.type_name AS typeName, sat.icon AS icon, sat.type_value AS typeValue FROM ( SELECT algorithm_code, tenant_id FROM vm_order_algorithms WHERE delete_flag = 0 AND tenant_id = #{body.tenantId} UNION SELECT algorithm_code, tenant_id FROM vm_order_algorithms_his WHERE delete_flag = 0 AND tenant_id = #{body.tenantId} ) t1 inner JOIN vm_algorithm_info_t t2 ON t1.algorithm_code = t2.algorithm_code inner JOIN vm_algorithm_alarm al ON t2.algo_min_type_code = al.algo_min_type inner JOIN sys_alarm_type sat ON al.alarm_type = sat.type_value WHERE sat.alarm_source = '1' and t2.app_scenarios = '1' ${body.dataScope} ORDER BY sat.alarm_type_id ASC ) t union SELECT DISTINCT sat.alarm_type_id AS alarmTypeId, sat.type_name AS typeName, sat.icon AS icon, sat.type_value AS typeValue FROM sys_alarm_type sat WHERE sat.alarm_source in
#{alarmSource}
and ((sat.tenant_id is null and sat.industry_code is null) or (sat.tenant_id = #{body.tenantId} and sat.industry_code = #{body.industryCode})) union SELECT DISTINCT sat.alarm_type_id AS alarmTypeId, COALESCE(sat.type_name, cfg.itemName) AS typeName, sat.icon AS icon, cfg.itemCode COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AS typeValue FROM ( SELECT algorithm_code FROM vm_order_algorithms WHERE delete_flag = 0 AND tenant_id = #{body.tenantId} AND industry_code = #{body.industryCode} UNION SELECT algorithm_code FROM vm_order_algorithms_his WHERE delete_flag = 0 AND tenant_id = #{body.tenantId} AND industry_code = #{body.industryCode} ) algo INNER JOIN vm_algorithm_info_t a ON algo.algorithm_code = a.algorithm_code AND a.delete_flag = 0 AND a.algorithm_model_type = 2 INNER JOIN JSON_TABLE( a.model_config, '$[*]' COLUMNS ( code VARCHAR(64) PATH '$.code', NESTED PATH '$.dictList[*]' COLUMNS ( itemCode VARCHAR(64) PATH '$.itemCode', itemName VARCHAR(128) PATH '$.itemName' ) ) ) cfg LEFT JOIN sys_alarm_type sat ON sat.type_value = cfg.itemCode COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AND sat.delete_flag = 0 AND ( (sat.source = 3 AND sat.tenant_id = #{body.tenantId} AND sat.industry_code = #{body.industryCode}) OR IFNULL(sat.source, 0) != 3 ) WHERE a.model_config IS NOT NULL AND a.model_config != '' AND LOWER(cfg.code) LIKE '%modetype%' AND cfg.itemCode IS NOT NULL AND cfg.itemCode != '' union
SELECT DISTINCT sat.alarm_type_id AS alarmTypeId, sat.type_name AS typeName, sat.icon AS icon, sat.type_value AS typeValue FROM sys_alarm_type sat WHERE sat.delete_flag = 0 AND IFNULL(sat.source, 0) = 3 AND sat.tenant_id = #{body.tenantId} AND sat.industry_code = #{body.industryCode} AND sat.type_value IS NOT NULL AND sat.type_value != ''

SELECT t3.type_value AS typeValue, t3.type_name AS typeName, t3.icon AS icon FROM sys_alarm_type t3 WHERE t3.source = '0' AND t3.delete_flag = '0'
AND t3.type_name like concat(concat('%',#{body.typeName}),'%')
ORDER BY t3.type_value

SELECT t3.type_value AS typeValue FROM sys_alarm_type t3 WHERE t3.delete_flag = '0'
AND t3.type_name like concat(concat('%',#{typeName}),'%')
select count(*) from vm_order_services_rel where tenant_id = #{body.tenantId} and ord_status in (0, 1, 2) and industry_code = #{body.industryCode} and service_code = '9' and delete_flag = 0

SELECT DISTINCT sat.alarm_type_id AS alarmTypeId, sat.type_name AS typeName, sat.icon AS icon, sat.type_value AS typeValue, voa.algorithm_code algorithmCode, IFNULL(sat.alarm_source,'1') as alarmSource, IFNULL(dict.DICT_LABEL,'AI告警') as alarmSourceName FROM vm_order_algorithms voa inner join vm_algorithm_info_t ai on voa.algorithm_code = ai.algorithm_code inner join vm_algorithm_alarm aa on ai.algo_min_type_code = aa.algo_min_type inner join sys_alarm_type sat ON aa.alarm_type = sat.type_value left join sys_dict_data dict on sat.alarm_source = dict.DICT_VALUE and dict.DICT_TYPE = 'warning_source_common' WHERE sat.delete_flag = 0 and sat.alarm_source = '1' and ai.delete_flag = 0 and aa.delete_flag = 0 and voa.delete_flag = 0 and sat.alarm_source = '1' and voa.tenant_id = #{body.tenantId} and voa.ord_status in (0, 1, 2) and voa.industry_code = #{body.industryCode} ${body.dataScope} ORDER BY aa.alarm_type

(select DISTINCT sat.alarm_type_id AS alarmTypeId, sat.type_name AS typeName, sat.icon AS icon, sat.type_value AS typeValue FROM vm_order_algorithms t1 inner JOIN vm_algorithm_info_t t2 ON t1.algorithm_code = t2.algorithm_code inner JOIN vm_algorithm_alarm al ON t2.algo_min_type_code = al.algo_min_type inner JOIN sys_alarm_type sat ON al.alarm_type = sat.type_value WHERE sat.delete_flag = 0 and t2.app_scenarios = '1' and t2.delete_flag = 0 and al.delete_flag = 0 and t1.delete_flag = 0 and t1.ord_status in (0, 1, 2) AND t1.tenant_id = #{body.tenantId} ${body.dataScope} ORDER BY sat.alarm_type_id ASC) union SELECT DISTINCT sat.alarm_type_id AS alarmTypeId, sat.type_name AS typeName, sat.icon AS icon, sat.type_value AS typeValue FROM sys_alarm_type sat WHERE sat.delete_flag = 0 and sat.alarm_source = '4'
SELECT type_value, type_name, ifnull(icon,'') as icon FROM sys_alarm_type
mapper.insert:
insert into sys_alarm_type (alarm_source, type_value, type_name, source,icon, delete_flag, creator, create_time, tenant_id, industry_code) values
( #{alarmType.alarmSource,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{alarmType.typeValue,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{alarmType.typeName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '0', #{alarmType.icon,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '0', #{alarmType.creator,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, now(), #{alarmType.tenantId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{alarmType.industryCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
mapper.select: select id from vm_screen_data_config_count where screen_id = #{screenId} and screen_type = #{screenType} and tenant_id = #{tenantId} and industry_code = #{industryCode} and app_ver_code = #{appVerCode} and is_customize = '1'
select data_source as source, data_code as code from vm_screen_data_config where screen_data_config_id = #{screenConfigId} and data_type = '9' and data_source = '3' and delete_flag = '0'
select algorithm_code, algorithm_name from vm_algorithm_info_t where algorithm_model_type = 2 and delete_flag = 0

SELECT DISTINCT sat.alarm_type_id AS alarmTypeId, COALESCE(sat.type_name, cfg.itemName) AS typeName, sat.icon AS icon, cfg.itemCode COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AS typeValue FROM ( SELECT algorithm_code FROM vm_order_algorithms WHERE delete_flag = 0 AND tenant_id = #{body.tenantId} AND industry_code = #{body.industryCode} UNION SELECT algorithm_code FROM vm_order_algorithms_his WHERE delete_flag = 0 AND tenant_id = #{body.tenantId} AND industry_code = #{body.industryCode} ) algo INNER JOIN vm_algorithm_info_t a ON algo.algorithm_code = a.algorithm_code AND a.delete_flag = 0 AND a.algorithm_model_type = 2 INNER JOIN JSON_TABLE( a.model_config, '$[*]' COLUMNS ( code VARCHAR(64) PATH '$.code', NESTED PATH '$.dictList[*]' COLUMNS ( itemCode VARCHAR(64) PATH '$.itemCode', itemName VARCHAR(128) PATH '$.itemName' ) ) ) cfg LEFT JOIN sys_alarm_type sat ON sat.type_value = cfg.itemCode COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AND sat.delete_flag = 0 AND ( (sat.source = 3 AND sat.tenant_id = #{body.tenantId} AND sat.industry_code = #{body.industryCode}) OR IFNULL(sat.source, 0) != 3 ) WHERE a.model_config IS NOT NULL AND a.model_config != '' AND LOWER(cfg.code) LIKE '%modetype%' AND cfg.itemCode IS NOT NULL AND cfg.itemCode != ''
AND algo.algorithm_code IN
#{item}
AND COALESCE(sat.type_name, cfg.itemName) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{body.typeName}, '%')
ORDER BY typeName, typeValue
